Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning public access to lands acquired in whole or part with public funds.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to public access to lands acquired in whole or partwith public funds; adding a new section to chapter 79A.25 RCW; addinga new section to chapter 77.12 RCW; adding a new section to chapter43.30 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 43.21A RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 79A.05 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter90.71 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 79A.25 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1)(a) When providing any funds for or reimbursing expenses fromthe fee simple acquisition of real property, state agencies mustensure, through means such as contracts or deed restrictions, that thegeneral public has regular access to the real property for purposesincluding outdoor recreation. (b) State agencies may approve a request to limit the generalpublic's access to a property: (i) Consistent with the statutoryconditions of a funding or reimbursement program; or (ii) to addresssignificant risks to cultural and natural resources or significantimpacts to adjacent landowners. p. 1 SSB 5057 (c) Any limitations on general public access must be narrowlytailored, with regards to timing, geographic area, and allowable uses,to address the specific risks or impacts identified. (2) This section applies to any funds distributed by or reimbursedfrom a state agency, including the office and the boards administeredby the office, the department of natural resources, the department offish and wildlife, the Puget Sound partnership, the state parks andrecreation commission, and the department of ecology, for purposes ofthe fee simple acquisition of real property through grant programs orother funding mechanisms, including for purposes of salmon recoveryfunding, estuary restoration, or through the Washington wildlife andrecreation program.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall comply with the applicable requirements ofsection 1 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.30 RCWunder the subchapter heading "Part 5 powers and duties-general" toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall comply with the applicable requirements ofsection 1 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall comply with the applicable requirements ofsection 1 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 79A.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The commission shall comply with the applicable requirements ofsection 1 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 90.71 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The partnership shall comply with the applicable requirements ofsection 1 of this act.
